title: 第3章 入赘
slug: 斗罗开局被逼入赘对象宁荣荣
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

与此同时，江蓠只感觉一股奇异的能量缓缓渗入体内，而体内已经枯竭的魂力在这股能量的作用下，竟开始快速地恢复着。

好神奇的能力，这就是辅助类魂技么？

面对着吸收魂环的关键时期，来不及细想这俩人的目的，敛去杂念，将全部心神投入到魂环的吸收中。

两个小时后，夕阳已经西沉，在大地上拉出一道长长的影子。

此刻，第六道魂环已经彻底融入蛛儿体内，气息也已经稳固。

因为反哺，她体内的魂力也开始了攀升，虽然因为没人教导的缘故，她还不清楚自己具体的等级，但根据魂力的增幅波动，她的等级绝对在六十五级以上。

具体，只能回去再测试了。

收拾好心绪，江蓠缓缓睁开眼，眸中淡淡的红光渐渐消退，站起身，这才将目光投向宁风致，微微躬身行了一礼。

宁风致微微颔首，目光温和却藏着一抹说不明的味道。

“不必多礼，鄙人宁风致，七宝琉璃宗宗主。来这里也只是有些私事，帮你也只是顺手而为。”

顿了顿，宁风致继续问道。

“小兄弟天赋不错，看着有些面生，想来不是我天斗帝国之人吧？”

语气随意，仿佛只是寻常的寒暄，但落在江蓠耳中，却是让她心头微微一震。

宁风致！

七宝琉璃宗宗主！

怎么这么巧遇到这两人，之前感受到的杀气并不是错觉。

意外捡回一条命。

江蓠心头一凛，垂下眼帘，掩去眸中的警惕。没有开口，只是微微摇了摇头。

宁风致眉头微不可察地皱了皱。

不说话？哑巴？

“哼。”见此一幕，古榕不由冷哼一声。

“小子，挺猖狂啊，帮你这么大忙，连句谢谢都没有。”

宁风致却是摆了摆手说道。

“骨叔，或许是小兄弟有什么难言之隐也说不定。”

面上依旧挂着温和的笑容，但眉宇间也多了一抹异样，微不可察。

感受着有些压抑的气氛，江蓠嘴唇动了动，却也不知道该怎么回答。

难道说，自己真的不太会说话？

Page (1/3)

At the same time, Jiang Li felt a strange energy slowly seeping into her body, and the depleted soul power in her body began to recover quickly under the influence of this energy.

What a magical ability. Is this an auxiliary soul skill?

Facing the critical period of absorbing the soul ring, there was no time to think carefully about the purpose of these two people, put away distracting thoughts, and put all the concentration into absorbing the soul ring.

Two hours later, the sun had set in the west, casting a long shadow on the earth.

At this moment, the sixth soul ring has been completely integrated into Zhuer's body, and his aura has become stable.

Because of the feedback, the soul power in her body also began to rise. Although she didn't know her specific level because no one taught her, but according to the increase in soul power, her level was definitely above level sixty-five.

Specifically, I can only go back and test again.

After gathering her thoughts, Jiang Li slowly opened her eyes, and the faint red light in her eyes gradually faded away. She stood up, then turned her eyes to Ning Fengzhi, and bowed slightly.

Ning Fengzhi nodded slightly, his eyes gentle but hiding an unexplainable flavor.

"No need to be polite, I am Ning Fengzhi, the sect leader of the Qibao Glazed Sect. I am here just for some personal matters, and I am just doing my best to help you."

After a pause, Ning Fengzhi continued to ask.

"My little brother is very talented, but he looks a little unfamiliar. I guess he's not from my Tiandou Empire, right?"

The tone was casual, as if it was just ordinary greetings, but when it fell in Jiang Li's ears, it made her heart slightly shaken.

Ning Fengzhi!

The master of Qibao Glazed Sect!

How come I met these two people so coincidentally? The murderous aura I felt before was not an illusion.

Accidentally saved a life.

Jiang Li's heart trembled, and she lowered her eyes to cover up the vigilance in her eyes.He didn't speak, just shook his head slightly.

Ning Fengzhi frowned imperceptibly.

Not talking?Dumb?

"Humph." Seeing this scene, Gu Rong couldn't help but snorted coldly.

"Boy, you are so arrogant. I have helped you so much without even saying thank you."

Ning Fengzhi waved his hand and said.

"Uncle Bones, maybe the little brother has something to hide."

There was still a gentle smile on his face, but there was something strange between his eyebrows, which was almost imperceptible.

Feeling the somewhat depressing atmosphere, Jiang Li moved her lips, but she didn't know how to answer.

Could it be that I really don’t know how to speak?
